operating_income.source: PROXY: operating income not reported in XBRL (null in deskstack). Computed as pretax income (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes...: 29584/27506/19743) plus InterestExpenseDebt (469/594/1217), accession 0000093410-26-000078. Includes equity affiliate income and other items; reviewer should replace with the 10-K figure.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: modest recovery after FY2025 revenue decline of 6.8% (189,031 vs 202,792), then roughly inflation-level growth; commodity prices not forecast.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 proxy margin 11.1% (20,960/189,031), FY2023-25 range 11.1%-15.0%; mid-cycle slightly above trough.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Damodaran US Oil/Gas (Integrated) effective tax rate 28.2% (betas dataset 2026-01-05).

wacc.source: Assumption. CAPM check: Rf 4.86% (US 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~0.31 (Damodaran cash-corrected unlevered 0.278, D/E 0.138) x ERP 4.46% = ~6.2% cost of equity, WACC ~5.7%. Judged too low for a commodity-exposed company (industry beta from only 4 firms), so 7.5% used as conservative judgement.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and long-run inflation; allows for energy transition headwinds.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 50,699 (ltd_noncurrent 39,781 + debt_current 10,918) - cash 7,285 - STI 0; accession 0000093410-26-000078
